nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/EXTRACT_REPORT.md — the laptop extraction's own accounting: sources, counts, per-rule reject tallies, kept turns per month, and the verification section. Tool output, read to judge how much intent the filter dropped

The laptop pass's counts and per-rule rejects: 10,313 user-role records seen, 9,547 rejected, 90 duplicates collapsed, 676 kept. The per-rule table sums to the rejected total: 6,380 + 2,530 + 373 + 202 + 45 + 16 + 1 = 9,547, with harness_template the largest bucket at 6,380. Every figure describes the 2026-08-03 snapshot that produced the file; the laptop transcripts are live and still growing, so a fresh run reports a larger `seen`

The laptop report's verification sections: 1 an audit of the harness_template rule, the largest reject bucket, checked three ways with 0 human turns lost; 2 the shape of the corpus — why 6,420 files yield only 28 sessions; 3 nothing exists before 2026-07-06 on this machine; 4 byte-identity verification of kept turns against their source transcripts; 5 the 90 collapsed duplicates were true duplicates, all matching on (timestamp, text) to the millisecond across sibling copies of one session and 0 matching on uuid. Plus a trustworthiness section and a reconciliation
